pages.text:
Osmotic and hydrostatic driving pressures
Π = RT c.
Jin = LpAm{∆Π − ∆P }.
Greater internal osmotic pressure draws water inward; greater internal hydrostatic pressure
opposes it.

pages.title: Euler dynamics near equilibrium
pages.text:
Euler dynamics near equilibrium
ηn+1 ≃ (1 − h/τ )ηn.
Stability: 0 < h/τ < 2.
Nonalternating local relaxation: 0 < h/τ ≤ 1.
Both diﬀer from an accuracy requirement.
Mathematical Modeling Notes 14 / 19

pages.title: Additional mechanisms for cell-volume regulation
pages.text:
Additional mechanisms for cell-volume regulation
Permeant ions require amount balances.
Hydrostatic pressure requires mechanics.
Active transport requires pump ﬂuxes.
The present water-only calculation isolates osmosis; it does not establish cell survival or
physiological regulation.
Mathematical Modeling Notes 19 / 19
